dialogues.text: Who is it!? Who's there?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}. One who belongs to this era.

dialogues.speaker: Alara
dialogues.text: Ah. Well, though I know nothing of your time, my name is Alara. I was once an Ascetic of the Age of Silence.

dialogues.speaker: Alara
dialogues.text: I no longer remember how much time has passed since I came here. Even this place has broken my silent cultivation.

dialogues.speaker: Alara
dialogues.text: So it is true... cultivating a mind without thought or desire leads one to reincarnate in the Unthinking Heaven of Evil...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No need to thank me.

dialogues.speaker: Alara
dialogues.text: Well, thanks all the same!

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Saving you was more of a spur-of-the-moment thing. That said, we're planning to look for a way out that isn't meditation.

dialogues.speaker: Alara
dialogues.text: Are you not practiced in that art? Or is it simply not taught in your era?

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: The first time I left this place, it took me hundreds of years. I gave up my pursuit of truth... and my longing to see my loved ones again.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: This time, I'm not willing to give any of those up.

dialogues.speaker: Alara
dialogues.text: That makes two of us.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Dex has picked up another Deathmuse Shard.

dialogues.speaker: Alara
dialogues.text: Deathmuse? Ah, you mean the Maranasati meditation technique. I know of it, and its use in cultivating one's mental state when facing death.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Now that Zeitlind's been found, let's try to find a way out.

dialogues.speaker: Alara
dialogues.text: Are you sure we can get out of here by ourselves?

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Melanta and Nihilita can move within this place freely, and they usually bring people with them. In which case, Dex should be able to do the same.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: That's three Deathmuse Shards collected.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Though I should say this is a temporary name, since I have no clue what Dex will be using them for either.

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: What next, Dex?

dialogues.speaker: Istoria
dialogues.text: Let's follow its directions.
